items.claim: Elise Reed frequently gets finished by lower-level fighters in the UFC.
items.quote: Elise Reed is not very good. She gets finished at the lower-level ladies fights in the UFC.

items.claim: Chanelle Dyer is a promising kickboxer with power and defensive grappling ability.
items.quote: And Chanelle Dyer is a pretty damn promising kickboxer. Sometimes she's hot, sometimes she's a little cold, but she has some power, some kinetic energy behind her strikes. She's got some defensive grappling ability

items.claim: West Shultz relies on pulling guard and Hail Mary submissions because he lacks other skills.
items.quote: West Shultz is just a guard-pulling, throw-up-a-submission Hail Mary because he doesn't have the skills or the heart to deal with other places.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has long lanky arms and possesses good choking submissions.
items.quote: Jackson McVey has nice chokes of his own. He's got some long-ass lanky arms that'll slap some chokes on you.

items.claim: Gage Young has a good jab and a nice right hand thrown over the top.
items.quote: Gage Young has a pretty good jab, pretty nice right hand he throws over the top.
